messages:
Jun Park: Heads up — scheduling a short maintenance window for az23 tonight to suppress an intermittent BGP flap that spikes egress and causes GPU eviction churn. Affected pool: az23-gpu-pool
Alex Kim: ETA? impact? :eyes:
Jun Park: Target window: 00:30–01:15 UTC. Plan is a rolling suppress (not full soft-drain) on the top-of-rack switches + controlled node reboots for nodes showing NIC flap >3x in 15m. Expect brief p99 latency blips, but we’ll keep pods on other nodes.
Olivia Patel: Can we avoid mass pod evictions? Last time the prefix cache cold-start killed perf for 20m.
Jun Park: Yes — we’ll set kube-interruption-mode=evict=false where possible and use kubectl cordon + drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --timeout=5m for canary nodes only. Full command I’ll run for canary: `kubectl drain node/az23-node-047 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --timeout=5m`
Samir Rao: How many GPUs in the pool? cost/backfill implications?
Jun Park: az23-gpu-pool = 120 GPUs (30 nodes x4g). Canary cohort: 3 nodes (~12 GPUs). Backfill plan: route low-priority jobs to reserved-burst pool, reserve 10 GPUs for customer-critical traffic. Expected transient capacity loss ~10% worst-case.
Alex Kim: Who’s on pager? Need someone to watch scheduling and eviction metrics during the window.
Olivia Patel: I can monitor pods/policies and prefix cache hit rate + latency dashboards. Samir can watch capacity and billing alarms.
Samir Rao: Will raise a temporary quota spike to avoid auto-scale spinups that could suck capacity elsewhere. Also putting cost watch on reserved-burst usage — ping me if >25% of reserved used.
SRE Bot: maintenance-scheduler: Scheduled maintenance created: az23 BGP suppress + node targeted reboots — 2026-03-21 00:30 UTC — owner: Jun Park. Notifying customer-facing channels.
Jun Park: Communication note: send external alert to affected tenants with 2h notice and include fallback to other regions. I drafted the notice, will post in #customer-success.
Olivia Patel: Add a step to pre-warm KV/prefix cache on nodes that will receive rerouted traffic: `curl -X POST https://internal-cache/seed?pool=az23-gpu-pool` — run 10m before canary.
Alex Kim: For network team — are we toggling BGP dampening or suppressing specific neighbor flaps?
Jun Park: We’ll temporarily increase flap-dampening thresholds and apply a soft-suppress on the flapping neighbor for 45m. Network will coordinate; ops will run the suppress and then verify route stability for 10m before proceeding to node reboots.
Samir Rao: Rollback plan?
Jun Park: If flaps persist or p95 latency >250ms for >5m, abort remaining reboots and revert BGP suppress. Manual rollback steps in runbook. Also automatic fallback: route traffic through global-egress-1 for customers with failover enabled.
Olivia Patel: Metrics to watch: pod_eviction_rate, prefix_cache_miss_ratio, p95_latency_generation, gpu_utilization, reserved-burst-usage. I’ll set a temporary dashboard and alert thresholds.
Alex Kim: Canary cadence?
Jun Park: Canary 1 (3 nodes) at 00:35, observe 15m. Canary 2 (6 nodes) at 00:55, observe 15m. If both green, proceed with 10-node cohorts until complete. Full ops doc attached in the thread (see link).
Samir Rao: Cost note: if we spill >8% of active jobs to on-demand clouds, estimate ~$2.5k/hr. I’ll authorize up to $5k emergency budget for the window.
Olivia Patel: Post-maint checks: KV cache warmness >=90%, pod_restores_success >=99%, and no CSI failures. If any fail, open incident.
Jun Park: Assigning runbook owners: Jun (executes node actions), Olivia (observability), Samir (capacity & billing), Alex (customer comms). Ping @here 30m before start. :thumbsup:
DevEx Bot: reminder: run preflight script `scripts/maintenance/preflight.sh az23` 20m before window.
Alex Kim: I’ll draft the customer-facing blurb and coordinate with CS.
Jun Park: Great — last call for objections. If none by 21:30 UTC, I’ll mark this schedule green and start preflight.
Olivia Patel: No objections from infra on my side.
Samir Rao: Good to go.
Jun Park: Cool — thanks team. I’ll post the public notice and we’ll meet in the war room channel during the window. :coffee:
